issues.body: Bead 2 still defines `worker_no_change_max_unattributed` as an integer with default `0` and says only that it needs no float-branch edit. The current `_thresholds_of` validator accepts `worker_success_floor` as its sole bounded numeric special case; every other non-curator threshold must be a non-boolean integer greater than zero. Therefore an explicit policy override of the documented zero boundary raises `must be a positive integer`. The design must specify the validator change needed to make its recommended fail-closed boundary implementable.
issues.fix_hint: Add a dedicated `_thresholds_of` validation case for `worker_no_change_max_unattributed` accepting non-boolean integers `>= 0` (and state an upper bound if intended). Update the bead-2 surface/implementation text and acceptance criteria to require that `0` is accepted while `-1`, booleans, and non-integers are rejected.
issues.title: The zero unattributed threshold is still incompatible with policy validation

verdict.summary: The round-3 major finding remains materially unchanged. The design still specifies `worker_no_change_max_unattributed` with default `0` while saying it needs no relevant validator edit, but the existing `_thresholds_of` positive-integer fallback rejects zero. As written, the recommended fail-closed default cannot be supplied as a policy override. Because the same major issue persists at the same severity, progress is stagnant.
